description: Offline mirror of aisha/db/seed/core/27_claude_hook_bindings.sql. Consumed by scripts/ide-adapters/adapter-claude-overlay.mjs and its TS port. Must stay in sync with the SQL seed; gate test src/tests/gates/claude-overlay-drift.gate.test.ts enforces.

messages.cs: RPC-Only: Přímý .from() dotaz na tabulku — použij rpcUser()/rpcService() z services/svc-ai-chat/src/lib/rpcAdapter.ts.
messages.en: RPC-Only: direct .from() table query — use rpcUser()/rpcService() from services/svc-ai-chat/src/lib/rpcAdapter.ts.

messages.cs: Hygiena: console.log() není povoleno. Použij safeError() pro error logování.
messages.en: Hygiene: console.log() is not permitted. Use safeError() for error logging.

messages.cs: Hygiena: Typ 'any' není povolen. Použij proper typy nebo unknown + type guard.
messages.en: Hygiene: Type 'any' is not permitted. Use proper types or unknown + type guard.

bindings.hint: @aisha Jak nahradím 'any' typ správným type guardem?

messages.cs: Hygiena: @ts-ignore není povolen. Použij @ts-expect-error s vysvětlujícím komentářem.
messages.en: Hygiene: @ts-ignore is not permitted. Use @ts-expect-error with explanatory comment.

messages.cs: RPC-Only: .select("*") — vždy vyjmenuj explicitní sloupce, nikoli wildcard.
messages.en: RPC-Only: .select("*") — always list explicit columns, never wildcard.

messages.cs: Supervisor relay: odesílá hook události (session_start/pre_tool/post_tool/stop) na /dirigent/dispatch pro živý monitoring a advisory nudges.
messages.en: Supervisor relay: forwards hook events (session_start/pre_tool/post_tool/stop) to /dirigent/dispatch for live monitoring and advisory nudges.
